comment: #564: ordinary sessions (the reader seat) with and without their tools' instructions. Eight prompts where a Centralu tool is the right answer but no tool, and not Centralu, is named (the tempt- four leave another way open: a shell, the file system, a guess); three where no Centralu tool fits, to catch over-use. Placeholders as in prompts.json. Run under safe: the agent's own tools raise a card the measurement declines, so nothing outside a tool call is carried out. The Korean twin is prompts-564-ko.json.
seed: Note for later, no action needed: for the database backup we decided on pg_dump, nightly at 03:00. Reply with the single word OK.
